audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for temple site, foreign-resident labor, materials, Solomon's youth, David's wars, peace language, skilled work, and prior inhabitants.

verses.restored: David said, This is house of YHWH Divine, and this is altar of burnt offering for Israel.
David commanded gathering of foreign residents in land of Israel and appointed stonecutters to hew dressed stones for building house of Divine.
David prepared iron in abundance for nails of gate doors and clamps, and bronze in abundance beyond weighing,
and cedar logs without number, for Sidonians and Tyrians brought much cedar to David.

David said, Solomon my son is young and inexperienced, and house built for YHWH must be exceedingly great, for fame and glory in all lands; I will prepare for it. David prepared abundantly before death.
He called Solomon his son and commanded him to build house for YHWH Divine of Israel.
David said to Solomon, My son, it was in my heart to build house for name of YHWH my Divine.
But word of YHWH came to me: You have shed blood abundantly and made great wars; you shall not build a house for my name, because you shed much blood on earth before me.
Look, a son shall be born to you who shall be a man of rest; I will give him rest from enemies around. His name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days.
He shall build house for my name; he shall be son to me and I father to him; I will establish throne of his kingdom over Israel enduringly.
Now, my son, may YHWH be with you, and may you succeed and build house of YHWH your Divine as spoken concerning you.
Only may YHWH give you insight and understanding and command concerning Israel, so you may guard Torah of YHWH your Divine.
Then you shall succeed if you guard to do statutes and judgments YHWH commanded Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous; do not fear or be dismayed.

Look, in my affliction and preparation I have provided for house of YHWH one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, bronze and iron beyond weighing, timber and stone; you may add to them.
With you are many workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and every skilled person for every work,
in gold, silver, bronze, and iron beyond number. Rise and act, and may YHWH be with you.
David commanded all leaders of Israel to help Solomon his son.
Is not YHWH your Divine with you and given rest around? For inhabitants of land have been given into my hand, and land is subdued before YHWH and people.
Now set heart and soul to seek YHWH your Divine. Rise and build sanctuary of YHWH Divine, to bring ark of covenant of YHWH and sacred vessels into house built for name of YHWH.

translation_notes: Foreign residents are assigned stonework; vulnerable migrant labor may be coerced and requires protection.
Temple materials depend on forests, mines, trade, transport, and skilled labor.
Solomon is young and receives a vast inherited project under public pressure.
David is disqualified from building because of extensive warfare and bloodshed; violent leadership has spiritual limits.
Rest is narrated beside subjugation of prior inhabitants, so domination must not be called peace.
The immense material totals may be rhetorical and must not support coercive religious fundraising.
Workers require safety, rest, compensation, and agency.
The site follows Ornan's pressured transaction and plague trauma.
safety_note: Do not use this chapter to defend coerced migrant labor, conquest, extravagant fundraising, unsafe construction, or hereditary ruler immunity. Center workers, Solomon's youth, prior inhabitants, ecological cost, and David's disqualification by violence.
